service_geography.verification_note: Confirm coach and in-person availability by ZIP code.

best_fit_roles: entrepreneur needing financial stabilization before financing
core_user_value: Provides financial education, individualized coaching, business planning, credit improvement support, and connections that help underserved people move toward business ownership and economic stability.

programs.name: Small Business Development
provides: connections to funding and outside resources
programs.typical_timeline: 8 to 12 weeks; verify current program structure

confirmed: Small Business Development serves aspiring entrepreneurs and new or existing small business owners.
1MBB is specifically designed for Black entrepreneurs and Black-owned businesses.

how_to_engage.primary: Register through the official Operation HOPE website and select the relevant coaching program.

what_to_have_ready: reliable contact information and ZIP code
brief description of the business idea or existing business
current business stage and main barrier
basic income, expense, debt, credit, and cash-flow information when relevant
existing business plan, registration documents, or financial records if available
a specific goal for the coaching period
questions_to_ask: Which program best fits my current business stage and immediate barrier?
Is a coach available for my ZIP code and how will meetings occur?
What attendance, homework, and documentation are required?
Can the coach help me become lender-ready, and how is readiness measured?
Which services are free and do optional partner tools have fees?
What referrals are available for legal, accounting, lending, or local technical assistance?
completion_measures: documented business goal and action plan
completed referral to the next needed provider

routing_logic.when: The user lacks business fundamentals, a plan, or structured coaching
Credit, debt, budgeting, or financial instability blocks progress
routing_logic.recommend: Credit and Money Management before or alongside business coaching

routing_logic.when: The user is a Black entrepreneur or Black-owned business

indypendent_bytes_alignment.role: Potential economic mobility, financial capability, and general business-readiness resource across INDYpendent Bytes pathways.
indypendent_bytes_alignment.mission_context: INDYpendent Bytes addresses economic barriers to employment and ownership for the Black community, domestic violence survivors, veterans, justice-impacted and reentering people, and others facing high barriers. Food systems and cultivation are major pathways, but not the entire mission.
indypendent_bytes_alignment.community_partnership_note: Kheprw Institute remains a priority relationship for Black-community trust, neighborhood-rooted engagement, and locally grounded economic development. Operation HOPE should complement—not replace—community-led partners.
indypendent_bytes_alignment.boundary: Do not represent Operation HOPE or Kheprw Institute as formal INDYpendent Bytes partners unless a formal relationship exists.

limitations: No guarantee of funding, approval, enrollment, or business success.
Do not confuse coaching with a direct loan or grant program.
Do not assume local in-person availability.
Professional legal, tax, accounting, licensing, or compliance advice may require separate providers.
current_status: active; verify time-sensitive details before recommendation
citation_rule: Use the current official Operation HOPE page for program, eligibility, cost, timeline, and enrollment claims.
